title: Comparison refuses a block content control, header, footer or text box that is empty in one version
symptom: compare refuses a block content control, a header or footer, or a text box that holds nothing in one version and paragraphs in the other ("cannot give an empty ... content, nor take all of it"), and a footnote or endnote both versions hold that compare cannot pair by id: a note reference in a tracked change, referenced twice or outside the main story, a note one version does not reference, or notes of an earlier comparison still pending (any other such note is deleted and inserted whole): no tracked change records the container itself, and the last paragraph mark of its content cannot be taken out, as the body's last cannot
workaround: give the empty container one empty paragraph in that version before comparing
